concerns.text: The idea explicitly asks to compare GWTC‑1/2 distributions with population predictions from the IllustrisTNG and EAGLE cosmological simulations. The specification drops this requirement, stating that those releases lack resolved component masses/spins and instead uses a synthetic power‑law catalog (see Assumptions and FR‑002). This constitutes a scope drift and under‑reach, and it violates Constitution Principle VI (Simulation Data Integrity) which mandates using the official IllustrisTNG/EAGLE releases.
